home.title:
Chess has
a third side.
home.description: Three armies circle the same board. Every move changes two rivalries. Only one king is left standing.
home.ruleBody: A 96-square ring with three four-rank home sectors. White, Black, then Red. Move clockwise and watch both sides.

game.selectPiece: Choose a piece, then a highlighted square.
game.confirmReset: Start a new game? The current position will be replaced.

rules.board: The 8 by 12 board wraps after rank 12. Files a–h stay in place.
rules.turns: White moves, then Black, then Red. All pawns move clockwise.
rules.pieces: Pieces keep their usual moves. Pawns promote to a queen on the next home sector.
rules.elimination: Checkmate takes a player out. Their pieces become still blockers. The last king wins.
